name: core-governance
description: Governance enforcement hooks from nic095layson/claude-core-skills: a prompt classifier that asks for the right governor on governed turns, a Stop gate that blocks a governed turn from finishing without a governor load, first-write reminders, the receipt-law gate, the post-compaction protocol, and turn gates on what a turn did (outward actions need plan-gate and adversarial-verify; a PR merge needs the owner's word).
